verdict.rationale: Bruno explicitly rejects cloud sync/shared workspace ('No cloud sync... Bruno is offline-only. There are no plans to add cloud-sync to Bruno, ever') and instead enables team sharing via Git version control of plain-text collection files, which requires each teammate to clone/pull/push via Git rather than a synced shared workspace. This satisfies the collaboration intent partially but not the literal 'synced shared workspace' mechanism. missing for 10: no real-time or automatic sync mechanism, no shared cloud workspace, collaboration depends entirely on external Git hosting and manual pull/push, and community evidence shows some rough edges in day-to-day usage (e.g. save issues) that could complicate shared collection editing.
